description: This file contains unit tests for the 'RequestViewer' React component, which is part of a logs display UI. The tests verify rendering of request details, request ID truncation, and display of LiteLLM overhead information based on log metadata.

classes.name: Row
classes.description: Type representing a row of log data, including an 'original' LogEntry object.

classes.name: LogEntry
classes.description: Type defining the structure of a log entry used in request logs, including request metadata, timing, and response info.

methods.name: createRow
methods.description: Helper function to create a mock table row with optional overridden LogEntry properties for testing.
